tasks.label: Install Node LTS and run Jalachakra
tasks.command: & { $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $version = 'v24.22.1'; $archiveName = "node-$version-win-x64.zip"; $url = "https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v24.x/$archiveName"; $expectedHash = 'd2046d28c2c3dcd211ac5145c0bf30e2047ef9dfb306693c8c6e2eccd8b95fa5'; $archive = Join-Path $env:TEMP $archiveName; $installRoot = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\node-v24.22.1'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $installRoot | Out-Null; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $archive; $actualHash = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $archive).Hash.ToLowerInvariant(); if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "Node archive checksum mismatch: $actualHash" }; Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $archive -DestinationPath $installRoot -Force; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $archive -Force; $nodeDir = Join-Path $installRoot "node-$version-win-x64"; if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $nodeDir 'node.exe')) -or -not (Test-Path (Join-Path $nodeDir 'npm.cmd'))) { throw 'Node archive extracted but node.exe or npm.cmd is missing.' }; $env:PATH = "$nodeDir;$env:PATH"; Write-Output (& (Join-Path $nodeDir 'node.exe') --version); Write-Output (& (Join-Path $nodeDir 'npm.cmd') --version); & .\start-dev.ps1 }

tasks.label: Install verified Node and start app
tasks.command: & { $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $version = 'v24.22.1'; $archiveName = ('node-' + $version + '-win-x64.zip'); $url = ('https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v24.x/' + $archiveName); $expectedHash = 'd2046d28c2c3dcd211ac5145c0bf30e2047ef9dfb306693c8c6e2eccd8b95fa5'; $archive = Join-Path $env:TEMP $archiveName; $installRoot = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\node-v24.22.1'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $installRoot | Out-Null; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $archive; $actualHash = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $archive).Hash.ToLowerInvariant(); if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw ('Node archive checksum mismatch: ' + $actualHash) }; Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $archive -DestinationPath $installRoot -Force; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $archive -Force; $nodeDir = Join-Path $installRoot 'node-v24.22.1-win-x64'; if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $nodeDir 'node.exe')) -or -not (Test-Path (Join-Path $nodeDir 'npm.cmd'))) { throw 'Node archive extracted but node.exe or npm.cmd is missing.' }; $env:PATH = ($nodeDir + ';' + $env:PATH); Write-Output (& (Join-Path $nodeDir 'node.exe') --version); Write-Output (& (Join-Path $nodeDir 'npm.cmd') --version); & .\start-dev.ps1 }

tasks.label: Diagnose backend startup
tasks.command: Write-Output 'Backend health:'; try { Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/health' -TimeoutSec 5 | ConvertTo-Json -Compress } catch { Write-Output $_.Exception.Message }; Write-Output 'Port 8000 listeners:'; Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 8000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Output 'Python processes:'; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'python.exe'" | Select-Object ProcessId,CommandLine | Format-List

tasks.label: Capture backend startup log
tasks.command: $out = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'jalachakra-backend-out.log'; $err = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'jalachakra-backend-err.log'; $proc = Start-Process -FilePath '.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe' -ArgumentList @('-m','uvicorn','app.main:app','--app-dir','backend','--host','127.0.0.1','--port','8000') -WorkingDirectory (Get-Location).Path -RedirectStandardOutput $out -RedirectStandardError $err -PassThru; Start-Sleep -Seconds 10; if (Get-Process -Id $proc.Id -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Output ('Backend process still running, PID ' + $proc.Id) } else { Write-Output 'Backend process exited during startup.' }; Write-Output '--- stderr ---'; if (Test-Path $err) { Get-Content -LiteralPath $err }; Write-Output '--- stdout ---'; if (Test-Path $out) { Get-Content -LiteralPath $out }; try { Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/health' -TimeoutSec 3 | ConvertTo-Json -Compress } catch { Write-Output ('Health probe: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }

tasks.label: Check backend health response
tasks.command: Write-Output 'Listeners:'; Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 8000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize; foreach ($path in @('/','/health','/docs')) { try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:8000' + $path) -TimeoutSec 30 -UseBasicParsing; Write-Output ($path + ' status=' + $response.StatusCode + ' body=' + $response.Content.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(500,$response.Content.Length))) } catch { Write-Output ($path + ' error=' + $_.Exception.Message) } }

tasks.label: Verify Jalachakra services
tasks.command: foreach ($url in @('http://127.0.0.1:8000/health','http://127.0.0.1:3000')) { try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -TimeoutSec 30 -UseBasicParsing; Write-Output ($url + ' => HTTP ' + $response.StatusCode); if ($url.EndsWith('/health')) { Write-Output $response.Content } elseif ($response.Content -notmatch 'JALACHAKRA') { throw 'Frontend response did not contain the expected app marker.' } } catch { Write-Error ($url + ' failed: ' + $_.Exception.Message); exit 1 } }
